query.$select: fiscal_year, upper(trim(title_description)) AS title, count(*) AS employees, median(base_salary) AS median_base, median(coalesce(regular_gross_paid, 0) + coalesce(total_ot_paid, 0) + coalesce(total_other_pay, 0)) AS median_total
query.$where: pay_basis = 'per Annum' AND leave_status_as_of_june_30 = 'ACTIVE' AND base_salary > 0 AND title_description IS NOT NULL
